platform.title: Platform
platform.subtitle: An integrated ecosystem of agents, correlation engines and dashboards designed for contextual runtime defense.

what.title: What is CJsmartOps
what.body: A modular platform that combines telemetry agents, containment engines and semantic analysis to provide unprecedented operational visibility. It is not a traditional SIEM nor a conventional EDR — it is a contextual observability layer.

how.title: How It Works
how.body: Agents collect process-level telemetry. Receivers normalize and route signals. The correlation engine detects patterns. CIPHER applies semantic intelligence. The dashboard presents everything in a unified view.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Independent modules that make up the CJsmartOps platform. Each solves a specific runtime defense problem.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.purpose: Genesis is the central nervous system of the platform. It orchestrates agents, correlates events and provides the operational dashboard.
genesis.problem: Multi-agent environments require a central coordination point. Without orchestration, agents operate in silos and cross-endpoint correlation is impossible.

aegis.name: AEGIS
aegis.purpose: AEGIS applies process-level containment policies. It detects fileless threats, manages quarantines and provides adaptive trust governance.
aegis.problem: Modern attacks evade file-based detection. A containment layer is needed that operates in memory, with reversibility and audit logging.

vigil.name: Vigil
vigil.purpose: Vigil collects process-level signals in a non-blocking manner. It establishes behavioral baselines and detects early deviations.
vigil.problem: Without behavioral baselines, operational anomalies and genuine threats are indistinguishable. Longitudinal telemetry with context is needed.

cipher.name: CIPHER
cipher.purpose: CIPHER enriches raw telemetry with contextual reputation scoring. It maps network flows, classifies relationships and detects anomalous communication patterns.
cipher.problem: Traditional network logs only show IPs and ports. Without semantic analysis, distributed attack patterns remain hidden in the noise.

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.purpose: Citadel provides secret management, at-rest encryption (Fernet AES) and key rotation for all platform components.
citadel.problem: Secrets scattered across config files and environment variables represent a critical risk. Centralized custody with verifiable encryption is needed.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.purpose: Sentinel generates audit reports, verifies compliance and provides forensic capabilities for post-incident analysis.
sentinel.problem: Security teams need traceable evidence for audits and compliance. Without immutable logs, accountability is impossible.

technology.title: Technology
technology.subtitle: The technical foundations that enable contextual observability, trust governance and runtime defense.

observability.title: Contextual Observability
observability.body: Unlike traditional metric-based monitoring, contextual observability captures the full runtime state: memory, process tree, network flows and filesystem interactions. This enables answering not just 'what happened' but 'why it happened'.

zero_trust.title: Zero Trust & Trust Governance
zero_trust.body: Trust is neither binary nor permanent. Our adaptive scoring model continuously evaluates each process's behavior. Scores decay toward neutrality and require sustained positive evidence to remain high.

telemetry.title: Semantic Telemetry
telemetry.body: CIPHER transforms raw logs into actionable intelligence. It classifies TCP flows with anomaly detectors, maps relationships between processes and endpoints, and assigns contextual reputation scores to each connection.

intelligence.title: Contextual Intelligence
intelligence.body: Longitudinal analysis over weeks of data enables establishing statistical baselines with high confidence. Drift detection identifies early deviations that static thresholds would miss.

custody.title: Cryptographic Custody
custody.body: All secrets, tokens and sensitive data are encrypted with Fernet AES. Keys rotate periodically. No secrets are stored in plaintext or transmitted without encryption.

impact.title: Low Operational Impact
impact.body: Agents with less than 40MB memory footprint. Non-blocking, rate-limited telemetry collection. Designed to run alongside production workloads without interference.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: CJsmartOps is a technology startup developing its own observability, trust governance and contextual defense platform.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Make contextual observability accessible for modern infrastructure, reducing operational noise and improving defensive explainability.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: Become the reference platform for telemetry-based cloud-native defense, with global recognition for its scientific approach and operational transparency.

approach.title: Approach
approach.body: Applied research. We observe before automating. Every alert includes a complete evidence chain. Decision-making is data-driven, not vendor claims.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.body: Adaptive trust scoring, reversible containment with audit logging, 8-layer supply chain validation, and minimal-footprint agents designed for cloud-native environments.

security.title: Security
security.body: Strict secret management policies. At-rest encryption with Fernet AES. No secrets in source code. Firewall-protected infrastructure with continuous monitoring.

origin.title: Origin
origin.body: CJsmartOps was founded by Carlos Suárez in Laboulaye, Córdoba, Argentina. The company operates with cloud infrastructure and a team focused on platform research and development.
